metadata.scenario: A prospect inquires about the availability of expert consultations for first-time users of the service. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is David Anderson. I was referred by Dorothy Henderson. Oh, yes! Dorothy is a wonderful client. How can I assist you? My wife is recovering from a stroke, and I'm looking for physical therapy and nursing care for her. I’m sorry to hear about your wife, David. We can certainly help with that. That would be great. Is there an expert I can consult about the services? Yes, I can connect you with one of our specialists. Would you prefer to talk to a physical therapist or a nurse? A physical therapist would be ideal, I think. Perfect. Our physical therapist, Dr. James Rodriguez, is available during the week. What’s his schedule like? He works Monday through Friday. Would you like me to schedule a consultation? Yes, please. What does that involve? The consultation will include an assessment of your wife's needs and a tailored therapy plan. That sounds good. How long does it usually take? The assessment typically lasts about 45 to 60 minutes. And what’s the cost for that? It ranges from $110 to $140 for the session. Alright, I’d like to proceed. When can we schedule? Let me check Dr. Rodriguez's availability. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. He has openings on Tuesday and Wednesday next week. Does either of those work for you? Wednesday works better for us. Great! What time would you prefer on Wednesday? How about 10 AM? That works perfectly. I’ll schedule that for you. Thank you! Also, do you provide nursing care? Yes, we offer skilled nursing care as well for medication management and other needs. What’s the cost for that service? It ranges from $95 to $125 per visit, depending on the specific services required. Sounds reasonable. Can you also provide that alongside the therapy? Absolutely, we can coordinate that after your consultation. Perfect! What do I need to do next? I’ll send you an email with the appointment details and a care plan questionnaire. Thank you! I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, David. We’re here to support you and your wife. I look forward to it. Have a great day! You too! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health.
